title: From Sukha Singh’s Martyrdom to Abdali’s Advance

blocks.text: Night falls after the action near Lahore, and the scattered Singhs choose to move towards Majha rather than remain exposed around the battlefield. The withdrawal is sober and practical, shaped by the loss of Sukha Singh and the recognition that survival now requires regrouping elsewhere.

The page then turns from immediate aftermath to a larger historical accounting. It dates Sukha Singh’s martyrdom and asks how Abdali advanced so far, drawing the answer through the deaths of allies such as Dewan Kaura Mal and the submission of Mir Mannu under Afghan pressure.

This makes the page a hinge between personal sacrifice and imperial consequence. A local martyrdom is set inside the wider reshaping of Punjab as Abdali rises through Lahore toward still greater dominance.
